text.en: Nakagawa's grammar is primarily based on the Saru dialect and frequently cites examples from the closely related Chitose dialect ⟦claim:sources/aims-scope-design-philosophy--nakagawa-grammar-saru-chitose-focus⟧; beyond these two, it also covers the Horobetsu, Shizunai, Ishikari (Asahikawa), Tokachi, and Shiranuka dialects ⟦claim:sources/aims-scope-design-philosophy--nakagawa-grammar-dialect-coverage⟧. Ainu exhibits dialect differences such that what is described for one dialect does not necessarily apply to all dialects ⟦claim:sources/aims-scope-design-philosophy--ainu-dialect-variation-generalizability⟧, and Satō (2008) accordingly restricts the term 'Ainu' to the Chitose dialect unless specifically noted otherwise ⟦claim:sources/aims-scope-design-philosophy--sato-grammar-chitose-scope-convention⟧. At the same time, Satō (2008) asserts that the basic grammatical points of Ainu do not differ substantially across dialects ⟦claim:sources/aims-scope-design-philosophy--ainu-basic-grammar-dialect-uniformity⟧, a position that contrasts with the recognition of inter-dialectal variation noted above ⟦claim:sources/aims-scope-design-philosophy--ainu-dialect-variation-generalizability⟧.
text.ja: 中川の文法書は沙流方言を基盤とし、近縁の千歳方言の用例も頻繁に引用しており⟦claim:sources/aims-scope-design-philosophy--nakagawa-grammar-saru-chitose-focus⟧、これら二方言に加えて幌別・静内・石狩（旭川）・十勝・白糠の各方言をもおもにとり上げている⟦claim:sources/aims-scope-design-philosophy--nakagawa-grammar-dialect-coverage⟧。アイヌ語には方言差が存在し、ある方言についての記述が必ずしもすべての方言に当てはまるわけではなく⟦claim:sources/aims-scope-design-philosophy--ainu-dialect-variation-generalizability⟧、佐藤（2008）はそれに応じて、特段の断りがない限り「アイヌ語」という表記を千歳方言に限定している⟦claim:sources/aims-scope-design-philosophy--sato-grammar-chitose-scope-convention⟧。一方で佐藤（2008）は、アイヌ語の文法における基本的な点は方言によってそれほど大きく異ならないと主張しており⟦claim:sources/aims-scope-design-philosophy--ainu-basic-grammar-dialect-uniformity⟧、この立場は上述の方言間変異の認識と対照をなしている⟦claim:sources/aims-scope-design-philosophy--ainu-dialect-variation-generalizability⟧。
